description: Implementation of the EmailService interface providing methods to send plain text and HTML emails using Thymeleaf templates within a Spring Boot application.

classes.name: EmailServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class for sending emails, implementing email functionality with support for simple text and Thymeleaf-based HTML emails.

methods.name: sendSimpleMessage
methods.description: Sends a plain text email message to the specified recipient with the given subject and text.

methods.name: sendMessageUsingThymeleafTemplate
methods.description: Generates and sends an HTML email using a Thymeleaf template and a data model.

methods.name: sendHtmlMessage
methods.description: Helper method to send an HTML email message to the specified recipient.
